title: Duskmere — A private dream journal and lucid-dreaming lessons
description: Capture a dream in dim light, connect recurring dreams in a Series, and explore cited lucid-dreaming lessons. Your meaning stays yours; no AI interpretation.
headline:
Catch the fragment
before it fades.
intro: A few words at 3 a.m. can be enough. Duskmere keeps dream capture close, saves a draft as you type, and gives you room to revisit recurring dreams later—without handing their meaning to an AI.
tagline: Write what you remember. Leave the meaning with you.
cardHeadline: Catch a dream before it fades. Keep a journal and explore lucid-dreaming lessons.
purchaseNote: Duskmere Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings at least 24 hours before renewal.

steps.title: Save the first fragment
steps.text: Open Capture in dim light. Write a phrase, add keywords, or use an available voice memo. Every keystroke saves a draft for when you wake.

steps.title: Connect what returns
steps.text: Link related dreams in your first free Series and use basic Signs to keep recurring images near their entries. You decide which connections matter.

steps.title: Read, reflect, or export
steps.text: Begin the first three cited lessons, revisit entries, and export the full journal as JSON, text, or PDF without a subscription. Premium opens the rest of the course and deeper tools.

features.title: A journal for the half-awake moment
features.text: Capture is designed for dim light and incomplete thoughts. You can return to a saved draft rather than trying to write a polished entry in the night.

features.title: Recurring dreams, kept together
features.text: A Series groups related dreams and their shared threads. One Series and basic Signs are free; unlimited Series, ongoing suggestions, and full Signs are Premium.

features.title: Learning with sources
features.text: Ten lessons cover recall, dream signs, reality checks, and lucid-dreaming techniques. Premium includes lessons 4–10 and the guided SSILD cycle through vision, hearing, and touch.

features.title: Exports that stay available
features.text: Full-journal JSON, text, and PDF exports are free. Premium adds filtered Dream Book PDF exports, rather than putting access to your whole journal behind a subscription.

included: Dream capture, saved drafts, and journal access
Your first Series and basic Signs
Full-journal JSON, text, and PDF exports
premium: Lessons 4–10 and the guided SSILD sense cycle
All 200 symbols, full Signs, and longer-horizon trends
Wake Back to Bed and custom reality checks
Unlimited audio memos and Series, ongoing Series suggestions, and filtered Dream Book PDF exports
privacy: Dream entries and voice memos stay on your device unless you choose to export or share them. No app account is required, and no AI reads your dreams.
Purchases and entitlement checks use Apple and RevenueCat. App updates use Expo; local activity storage does not mean the app never connects to the internet.
Exporting gives you a file to keep or share yourself. Treat a journal export as private information.
limitations: Duskmere is for journaling, education, and general wellness, not medical, sleep-therapy, or psychological advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
Symbols and recurring themes are for personal reflection, not authoritative dream interpretation. Lucid dreaming is not guaranteed.
Sleep-interruption techniques may not suit you. Prioritize rest, skip a technique when needed, and seek professional guidance about persistent nightmares or sleep concerns.
